decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Location Plan; Existing Plan (received on 11 September 2019); Proposed Crossover Revision B (received 14 November 2019) ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted is first brought into use, a visibility splay of 2.4 metres x 2.4 metres shall be provided on each side of the vehicular access (the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access). Thereafter, no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6 metres in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected, planted or allowed to grow within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 5 - Prior to first use of the vehicle crossover the 600mm high boundary wall shown on the plans hereby approved shall have been erected and thereafter retained as such
